treatment_summary.value: Antiepileptic drugs lamotrigine, oxcarbamazepine, levetiracetam (also in combination) and a short valproate trial (assumed side-effects; epilepsy therapy-resistant); vagus nerve stimulator implantation (followed by weeks without seizures); acetazolamide, attempted replacement by topiramate; currently topiramate and acetazolamide with regular emergency medication; melatonin for sleep disorder.

disease_label_as_stated.value: SSADH deficiency (succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency, SSADHD), severe phenotype

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Biochemical diagnosis at age two years: increased urinary GHB and γ-butyrolacton on organic acid analysis, elevated CSF GABA and GHB, and absent SSADH enzyme activity in lymphocytes; later Sanger sequencing of the whole ALDH5A1 coding sequence (done as part of a scientific evaluation) showing compound heterozygosity.

functional_evidence_statement.value: Reported (ref. [12]) to reduce SSADH enzyme activity to about 3% when expressed in vitro. FoldX: monomer ddG 7.20 kcal/mol; FFFF tetramer 28.09 kcal/mol (destabilizing); mixed tetramers with p.Leu243Pro 26.41-29.09 kcal/mol. Pathogenicity scores: SIFT 0.16, PolyPhen 0.972, REVEL 0.638. In the patient's fibroblasts (carrying both variants): ALDH5A1 mRNA expression no different from two controls; nearly complete absence of SSADH protein on Western blot; complete absence of SSADH enzyme activity in patient lymphocytes.

Patient fibroblasts (carrying both variants): ALDH5A1 mRNA expression no different from two controls; nearly complete absence of SSADH protein on Western blot. p.Leu243Pro construct transfected into SSADH-KO-HEK-293T cells: no protein expression and enzyme activity only 0.7% of wildtype. FoldX: monomer ddG 7.63 kcal/mol; PPPP tetramer 29.36 kcal/mol (highly destabilizing). Pathogenicity scores: SIFT 0, PolyPhen 0.999, REVEL 0.931. Leu243 conserved in all 30 closest mammalian SSADH sequences.
